protocol: All 14 official validation songs, fixed 60-90 second segments. Three independent timing runs on the same three songs. No test inference or custom-model training.
predeclared_exclusion: Overlap=4 is not expanded in this round because the previous pilot doubled compute for only 0.008 dB median gain; its original result remains reported.
limitations: Not whole-song or official test-set benchmarking
Public pretrained BS training split is undocumented
Scaled backing does not simulate physical microphone acoustics
Original vocals can contain production effects
Offline context is not causal or device latency
